question: Decision 0001 says shared links never expire. Does this change replace it, or add a choice beside it?

options.answer: Add a choice; links with no time never expire
options.rationale: Keeps decision 0001 for every link that picks no time.
options.yields: WHILE a link has no expiry time THE system SHALL keep it valid until it is revoked or its note is deleted

options.answer: Replace it: every link gets a default time
options.yields: WHEN a link is created with no time THE system SHALL give it a default expiry time

options.answer: Keep the decision and drop the change
options.yields: THE system SHALL keep every shared link valid until it is revoked

question: What happens to the links that already exist?

options.yields: IF a link was created before this change THEN the system SHALL treat it as having no expiry time

options.answer: They get a default time from today
options.rationale: Gives old links an end date.
options.yields: IF a link was created before this change THEN the system SHALL expire it a default time from today

options.answer: They get a default time from their creation
options.rationale: Many old links would end at once.
options.yields: IF a link was created before this change THEN the system SHALL expire it a default time from its creation

question: What does someone see when they open an expired link?

options.answer: A page that says the link expired
options.rationale: Matches how revoked links behave today.
options.yields: WHEN someone opens a link after its expiry time THE system SHALL show that the link has expired and SHALL NOT return the note

options.answer: The same not-found answer as an unknown link
options.yields: WHEN someone opens a link after its expiry time THE system SHALL answer as for an unknown link

question: A link can be revoked and can expire. Which wins, and does expiry sit behind the linkRevocation flag too?

options.answer: Either one ends the link; expiry is not behind the flag
options.rationale: Revocation is flagged; expiry is a separate change.
options.yields: WHILE a link is revoked or expired THE system SHALL NOT return its note

options.answer: Either one ends the link; expiry is behind the same flag
options.yields: WHILE the linkRevocation flag is on THE system SHALL end a link when it is revoked or expired

question: Who may set a time: any editor, or only the owner of the note?

options.yields: WHEN an editor shares a note and picks an expiry time THE system SHALL store that time on the new link
WHEN the note owner shares a note and picks an expiry time THE system SHALL store that time on the new link

question: Which clock decides that a link has expired, and is the end inclusive?

options.answer: The server clock, UTC, the instant is the end
options.yields: WHEN the server clock reaches a link's expiry time THE system SHALL treat the link as expired

options.answer: The server clock, the end of that day
options.rationale: The link works to the end of its last day.
options.yields: WHEN the server day of a link's expiry time ends THE system SHALL treat the link as expired

question: Should anyone be told before a link expires?

options.rationale: Nothing in the product notifies about links today.
options.yields: THE system SHALL NOT notify anyone before a link expires

options.answer: Yes, the note's owner, through the weekly digest
options.rationale: The digest already goes to owners.
options.yields: WHEN the weekly digest is built THE system SHALL list the owner's links that expire within 7 days
